To address this issue, we introduce a novel CSI dataset for Indian culture, belonging to 17 cultural facets.
Existing datasets for culture specific items (CSIs) focus primarily on concepts at the regional level and may contain false positives.
Large language models (LLMs) are widely used in various tasks and applications.

To measure the cultural competence of LLMs on a cultural text adaptation task, we evaluate the adaptations using the CSIs created, LLM as Judge, and human evaluations from diverse socio-demographic region.
